scope: All196 added propeller parts versus all856 D05 parts and each other at the default pose, plus corrected native motor references versus all fixed neighbors. Continuous conservative annular envelopes enclose full rotation of every added part. Hull intersections are candidates; separate exact-BRep blade phase witnesses on structural bodies confirm actual collisions. ISO envelope conflicts remain unresolved.52 foot-system cases versus all invariant annuli. Nominal rigid CAD, no deflection/tolerances/person envelope; motor-to-hub bolts not selected, OEM motor reference incomplete. Existing D05-to-D05 structural fastener tests are inherited, not rerun here.
